intro.text: A lestrell of the Diem who bets against Kenton in a game of Zo'Ken.
A lestrell of the Diem, able to work nine ribbons, who picks on Kenton.

items.text: Yeeden challenged Kenton to Zo'Ken and lost when Kenton destroyed all twenty-five targets with his single, very fast ribbon. Drile then arrived and scolded Yeeden for sparring with lowly acolents.
